items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: C.P. Johnson, who had had a band around town that I had been writing for

ctx.x: and Erroll, Harold West, and a bunch of other people. Then the record band started. This was in '47. So C.P. Johnson, who had had a band around town that I had been writing for, gets a gig in Honolulu...or not Honolulu but all the islands. So Trummy Young and Dexter and I, and Ulysses Livingston, and Arthur Dennis (and I can't think of the trumpeter's name at the moment), we all go to Honolulu. So just the day before we go to Honolulu, C.P. gets busted for marijuana. And the headlines when we get to Honolulu is,…
That was all you stayed in that one...
